summary: All 41 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes. Of 65 genes printed in Figure 3A–B, 64 matched individual registered coefficients. All 64 agreed in direction, and 44 met registered FDR < 0.05. The corrected proposal records a direct comparison so the Explorer no longer classifies the evidence as untested. It also clarifies the cohort evidence and documents a QC count discrepancy. The proposal passed validation.
openIssues: Fam205a2 shares a registered coefficient with Fam205a4 and remains unpaired.
Author effect sizes, gene-level RNA-seq P values and FDR, the exact model, and litter assignments remain unavailable in the reviewed sources. Genome-wide concordance remains unassessed.
The registered DE table and restored Explorer track both yield 478 discoveries at FDR < 0.05. The restored Explorer QC summary reports 1,344, and the separate analysis QC file reports 479.
